title: Riptide's Aqua PvP
description: This project remakes most of the items used in the spear mace kit to an aqua theme
body: This resource pack adds an aqua theme to some items in my favorite kit, spear-mace. This pack changes the look of the cobweb, totem of undying, mace, ender pearl, and wind charge. This is my second ever pack so hopefully you enjoy!
